correctness.rationale: Reconstructed exact block diagonalization f=(p+x,p-x,q+y,q-y), z=p-q with z_dot=-2z and (x,y)_dot=-[[2w+1,1],[1,3]](x,y). The Lipschitz unit ball is |x|,|y|<=1/2 and |z|+|x+y|<=1, whose extreme edge amplifications are max{alpha+(1+|w-1|)beta, e^-2t+|w-1|beta}. The killed-chain row sums are <=1. Spectral comparison alpha+beta>=e^-2t for w<=1 and <= for w>=1 produces the stated exact branches. Right derivative -min(2w,3-w) at 0 and semigroup submultiplicativity give best exponential exponent; w<=3 gives nonexpansion by beta<=t e^-2t and w>3 has positive short-time slope. The sharp global envelope 3/2 is unattained at finite w,t but attained in limit w->infinity, t=w^-1/2. Independent fresh 4x4 heat matrix and integral graph-Lipschitz polytope enumeration verified 50 w,t pairs, including thresholds; universal conclusions rest on analytic proof, not those finite cases.
